name: jinshuju-table-expert
description: Lightweight Jinshuju (jinshuju.net) tables designed for agents — create tables and read/write rows with natural language

displayDescription.en: Lightweight tables supporting multiple field types such as text and date, designed for agents, readable and writable anytime for collaboration.
displayDescription.zh: 轻量表格，支持文本、日期等多种字段类型，专为 Agent 设计，可随时读写协作。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我建一张办公用品领用台账，字段包括名称、数量、领用人、日期
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me create an office-supplies checkout ledger with columns for item name, quantity, recipient, and date.

quickPrompts.en: Help me create an office-supplies checkout ledger with columns for item name, quantity, recipient, and date.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我建一张办公用品领用台账，字段包括名称、数量、领用人、日期

quickPrompts.en: Summarize the last month of stock-in/out data in this inventory table and show me which items are consumed fastest.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这张库存表最近一个月的出入库数据汇总一下，看看哪些物料消耗最快

quickPrompts.en: From now on, automatically log each day's sales data into this table for me.
quickPrompts.zh: 以后帮我把每天的销售数据自动记到这张表里
